Past the radius, but since tangency-labs/solidcore#2988 the corner is the blend corner's Setback, whose fill is certified: at 3.5 the fill does not stay convex, so the setback is refused (NoRoom); solidcore names the least setback that builds it, 3.5595, which SolidCraft carries through its typed minimum-setback diagnostic (#13913); the kernel refusal test parses that minimum and verifies that it builds a valid body. The N x N patch built here before was uncertified. The right answer is the refusal.
